description: Check any public website or hosted MCP server once, right now, and get what AgentViva saw: works, partly works, does not work, or blocked (the site refused the check or asks bots not to open it, which does not mean it is down), with the evidence (HTTP status, where the redirects ended, the page title, or the MCP tools it lists). No API key needed. One check is a snapshot, not a verdict over time: for a tool AgentViva watches every day, lookup_tool gives its confirmed state and history. The same address is answered from a 5-minute copy. Private and local addresses are refused.

type.description: page (a website, the default) or mcp (a hosted MCP server).

url.description: The address, for example notion.so or https://example.com/mcp.

name: check_url
title: Is this address working right now?
